requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 实现一个简化电梯楼层与载荷监控系统，使用按钮 D2、D3、D4 表示到达 1 到 3 层，重量传感器 A0 表示载荷，蜂鸣器 D6、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）和 LED D13。系统显示当前楼层和载荷百分比；若载荷超限则蜂鸣报警并阻止楼层变化。按钮触发楼层切换时需要模拟移动延时，并在串口输出 movement complete。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: io_0 rising edge (io_0 true for one step), io_3 low so overload is false, then keep inputs unchanged until movement completes
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_6 eventually becomes 1; serial_0_trigger becomes true at movement completion step; io_4 is 0 and io_5 is false during non-overload

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 实现一个简化电梯楼层与载荷监控系统，使用按钮 D2、D3、D4 表示到达 1 到 3 层，重量传感器 A0 表示载荷，蜂鸣器 D6、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）和 LED D13。系统显示当前楼层和载荷百分比；若载荷超限则蜂鸣报警并阻止楼层变化。按钮触发楼层切换时需要模拟移动延时，并在串口输出 movement complete。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Set io_3 such that loadPercent>=80 (overload true), then apply rising edge on io_1 (request floor 2)
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_4 becomes 1000 (buzzer alarm), io_5 becomes true; current floor (io_6) does not change to 2; serial_1_trigger pulses true on overload state transition and serial_1_value_1 equals 2
